newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss shares end in negative territory.
newsitem.headline: Swiss shares end in negative territory.

text.p: 1440 GMT - Swiss shares took a slide near the end of the session to end a rangebound and quiet session slightly lower.

Dealers said the lack of follow-through buying and the reluctance of investors to take positions ahead of Friday's U.S. jobless data led the market down after initial gains. Several blue-chip stocks were seen close to support levels and may come under pressure if the negative tendency continues.
* Swiss Market Index (SMI) of leading shares lost 7.1 points, or 0.2 percent, to close at 3,627.1.
* All-share Swiss Performance Index (SPI) ended down 9.33 points, or 0.4 percent, closing at 2,325.91.
